label: IHG One Rewards
short_description: From InterContinental's flagship luxury to Holiday Inn Express's dependable budget stays.
intro: IHG One Rewards is InterContinental Hotels Group's loyalty program, spanning brands from ultra-luxury (InterContinental, Regent, Six Senses, Vignette Collection) through premium and lifestyle (Kimpton, HUALUXE, Hotel Indigo, voco, Crowne Plaza) to midscale and extended-stay options (Holiday Inn, Holiday Inn Express, avid, Staybridge Suites, Candlewood Suites). Elite status tiers -- Silver, Gold, Platinum, and Diamond -- unlock benefits like room upgrades, lounge access, and free breakfast, but exactly which perks a given hotel actually delivers varies by property and brand tier. This directory tracks that property-by-property reality rather than the program's general terms.

faqs.question: Does every IHG One Rewards hotel offer the same elite benefits?
faqs.answer: No -- elite benefits like lounge access, breakfast, and upgrade likelihood vary significantly by hotel and brand tier, even at the same status level. A Diamond member gets a stronger experience at a full-service InterContinental or Crowne Plaza than at a midscale Holiday Inn Express, and each hotel profile here notes what that property specifically provides.

faqs.question: How are these IHG One Rewards hotel reviews put together?
faqs.answer: Each listing combines verified property facts (address, brand, elite benefit details) with synthesized commentary drawn from public guest reviews and reporting, refreshed on a regular schedule. Every page shows when it was last checked and how many sources informed it.
